name: GD 3D Renderer
description: Editor OBJ preview with a trigger-driven 3D baseplate wireframe rig. Preserves the previous raster flipbook as a legacy bake option.

legacy-raster-bake.name: Legacy raster flipbook bake
legacy-raster-bake.description: Use the previous 32x32 pixel flipbook renderer instead of the new reusable baseplate rig. Enable this for dense models or when the transform-trigger rig does not work well.

baseplate-engine-info.name: Default: Baseplate transform rig
baseplate-engine-info.description: Creates one reusable stretched block per mesh edge and animates it with looping Move, Rotate and Scale triggers. The result runs without Geode. This first version uses sampled transform poses; Item Edit outputs cannot currently be wired directly into Move/Scale coordinate fields.

legacy-style.name: Legacy face colors
legacy-style.description: Start the preview in classic per-face colors instead of neutral grayscale shading.

legacy-outlines.name: Legacy outlines
legacy-outlines.description: Start the preview with silhouette and sharp-crease outlines enabled. Smooth internal triangle seams remain hidden.
